claim: All user data stored in DynamoDB is fully encrypted at rest. When creating a table you choose an AWS owned key (the default encryption type, no additional charge), an AWS managed key or a customer managed key, and you can switch between these key types at any time.

evidence.quote: AWS owned key – Default encryption type. The key is owned by DynamoDB (no additional charge).
When creating a new table, you can choose one of the following AWS KMS key types to encrypt your table. You can switch between these key types at any time.
All user data stored in Amazon DynamoDB is fully encrypted at rest.
